bitcoin_articles.headline: USBC, Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
bitcoin_articles.summary: USBC, Inc. reported a net income of $4.9 million for the third quarter of 2026, driven by a $25.7 million non-cash Bitcoin fair-value gain, while operating revenue remained at zero.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BitFuFu Announces October 2026 Bitcoin Production and Operational Metrics
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitFuFu reported its unaudited operational results for October 2026, highlighting a total of 1,454 BTC held and 137 BTC produced during the month.
